original_ai_output.title_zh: 河流州议会召回三名富巴拉支持者议员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚河流州议会撤销此前宣布三名议员席位空缺的决定，召回这三名在州政治危机期间被停职的议员。据议长媒体助理发表的声明，三人提交道歉信后获得复职。目前该消息为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 河流州议会召回三名效忠州长富巴拉的议员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Rivers State House of Assembly has recalled three lawmakers loyal to Governor Siminalayi Fubara

key_facts.fact: 三名议员此前在州政治危机期间被停职
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: who were suspended during the political crisis that rocked the state

key_facts.fact: 议会撤销了宣布三人席位空缺的决定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Assembly rescinded its decision to declare the seats of the three lawmakers vacant

key_facts.fact: 据称复职源于三人提交道歉信
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: their reinstatement followed letters of apology submitted by the lawmakers

uncertainties: 该消息目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
复职具体条件及后续安排尚未获其他来源确认
